about: The review targets the capture suites know how to photograph. Each target is reviewed and must pass by itself. To add one, write a capture test in unity/Assets/OrbitalAnte/Verification/Capture and list it here.

targets.name: Playtest mannequin (character, movement states, limb loss)
Combat as the player sees it (arena, enemies, gore, HUD)
Every world from space, and the flight readouts
Standing on the ground of seven worlds
Main menu, flight start, system map, pause menu

notYetCapturable.why: Milestone 7 (the starter ship, its interior, damage and glass) is not on main yet. Add a ship capture (hero set outside, interior views, seat, hatch, damage states) when it lands.

inspections.views.standard: The principal studio viewpoints: front, rear, left, right, front three-quarter, rear three-quarter, elevated three-quarter.
inspections.views.gameplay: Pictures through the game's own camera, as the player sees it.
inspections.animation.sequences: Motion judged from frame sequences (contact sheets) or live playback, never from one still.
inspections.technical.sceneChecks: The mechanical scene checks in the capture manifest were read and each error classified.
inspections.technical.tests: EditMode and PlayMode tests ran in Unity and their results were read.
